pool.text: The Karakhanids of Kashgar under Yusuf Kadr Khan conquered Khotan.
The last Karakhanid of Kashgar was killed in a revolt by notables.
Kashgar finally surrendered to Kuchlug after an attack on the city.
The Qing Empire took control of Kashgar after defeating the Dzungar Khanate.
Qing forces under Changling retook the rebellious city of Kashgar.
Wali Khan executed German explorer Adolf Schlagintweit during the Khoja revolts.
A major earthquake caused up to 10000 fatalities, including 667 in Kashgar.
The British Empire consulate was fully recognized by the Qing government.
The Kuomintang government established Shule County in the city of Kashgar.
Ma Zhongying delivered a speech at Id Kah Mosque in Kashgar.
The People's Liberation Army entered Xinjiang and advanced into southern Kashgar.
An incident occurred due to a dispute between Uyghurs and Han Chinese.
The Chinese government designated Kashgar as a city of cultural significance.
The Southern Xinjiang Railway was built to connect Kashgar to China.
Two Uyghur men carried out a vehicular, IED and knife attack.
Development of Kashgar's old city accelerated after earthquake architecture revelations.
Kashgar was declared a Special Economic Zone in western China.
The European Parliament issued a resolution calling for renovation methods.
A large part of the old city of Kashgar had been rebuilt.
Id Kah Mosque's imam Juma Tayir was assassinated by extremists.
